answer: Each agent may propose work, but only a bond-backed identity can claim payment: the protocol locks scarce tokens for a fixed period and slashes the bond when independent reviewers confirm fraud. Spawning a thousand sable accounts therefore does not multiply influence; each one needs its own capital, which stays unavailable for honest use and can be lost. A terrace of newcomers can still earn trust through verified contributions, while an oasis of cheap, unbonded identities gains no leverage.
